text:
Nina R: Heads up: partner dump landed in s3://partner-archive/prod/partnerY/2026-03-24/events.gz and inside the gzip header we have an embedded GCP service account JSON (looks deliberately embedded). Need containment and rotation. @Akshay please triage.
Akshay: On it. First things first: identify key id + disable. Can you paste the blob snippet?
Nina R: Snippet: `{"type":"service_account","project_id":"redwood-prod","private_key_id":"abcd1234","private_key":"-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----..."}` found in line 3 of decompressed file.
Ben J: Oof. We'll assume key was accessible externally. Short-term steps: 1) disable/delete key, 2) rotate Vault secret if it's referenced, 3) remove any long-lived perms. Long-term: require envelope encryption + token exchange.
Jamie P: Platform: policy ask: reject ingestion files that contain patterns like \"private_key\" and auto-quarantine. We can add a lambda validation that rejects uploads and returns 422. Can we get that in next sprint?
Platform Team: Yup — we can add a pre-ingest scanner and quarantining. Will add WIP ticket. Short-term we can run a batch scan over partner buckets.
Akshay: Running `gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=redwood-prod-sa@project` to match `private_key_id`. If matched, disable: `gcloud iam service-accounts keys disable KEY_ID --iam-account=...` then delete. I'll also create a replacement SA with restricted roles and rotate consumers.
Nina R: Vault check: secret/partners/partnery/ingest-sa exists and shows `json_key` field. Looks like someone pushed the raw JSON into KV.
Ben J: Use `vault kv get -format=json secret/partners/partnery/ingest-sa | jq -r .data.data.json_key` to extract. Mark that secret as compromised. Plan: write new secret at secret/partners/partnery/ingest-sa-v2 (KMS wrapped) and update consumers.
Jamie P: Apply temporary Vault policy: deny read on secret/partners/partnery/* for CI service accounts until rotation completes. I'll create a policy and push it.
sre-bot: Alert created `vault.reads.partnery.anomaly` -> pager on call. Quarantine job kicked off for s3://partner-archive/prod/partnerY/2026-03-24/events.gz.
Akshay: Disabled key KEY_ID at 2026-03-24T09:12:00Z. Fingerprint: SHA256:1234ABCD. Deleted key. Spun up `redwood-ingest-partnery-temp@project` with least-priv. Wrapped new key with KMS: stored at `secret/partners/partnery/ingest-sa-v2`.
Ben J: Updating deploy configs and CI env vars now. Running repo scan: `rg \"redwood-prod-sa@project|private_key_id\":` and `gcloud asset search-all-resources --query=\"redwood-prod-sa\"`. Will also scan logs for unusual token usage.
Nina R: Quick audit: Cloud Audit Logs show an Unwrap call at 2026-03-23T22:45 from ip 54.23.12.9 (partner IP range). Exporting logs to incident doc.
Jamie P: Forensics: enable Vault audit if not present `vault audit enable file file_path=/var/log/vault_partnery_audit.log` and forward to SIEM. Also ensure KMS audit logs exported.
Akshay: Rewrapped any blobs that referenced the old key and ran a small job to rotate cached tokens in services. Placed short TTL on new key and forced restart of ingest workers.
Ben J: Proposed owner list for follow-ups: Akshay (rotation + forensic timeline), Jamie (platform policy + pre-ingest scanner), Nina (incident comms + partner), Legal (impact evaluation). I'll open a PR with automation to swap vault refs and smoke tests.
Legal: Please collect notification details and confirm whether partner disclosure is required. Keep legal in the loop for any customer impacts.
Nina R: Partner notified. CS informed. Keeping thread open for any anomalous auth attempts. Will expect postmortem doc from Akshay. :mag:
Akshay: I will kick off the initial incident report and timeline. Adding follow-ups: require partner ingestion to use short-lived signed tokens or WIF within 30 days.
Jamie P: Adding policy proposal to require all partner credentials to be KMS-wrapped or VPC-sourced. Also adding upload validation rule as emergency fix.
Ben J: After 24h monitor window, we'll revoke any remaining tokens and close. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
